verdict.rationale: Gide has a dedicated 'Employee Share Schemes' practice page describing design/implementation of share ownership plans 'in France and internationally' with legal, tax and employment expertise, plus BSPCE-specific content, but no evidence names UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOP schemes specifically. Missing for 10: explicit mention of UK EMI plans, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOP frameworks, or any jurisdiction-specific equity plan documentation beyond France.
